title: Sports Day
scene: The finish line of a primary school sports day, where the leading runner stops to help a fallen classmate instead of winning the race.
questions: Describe what is happening in this picture.
Do you think the runner made the right choice? Why?
Tell me about a time you had to choose between winning and being fair.
Some people say winning is the most important thing in sports. Do you agree?
What does good sportsmanship look like at your school?
